# Whispy

> Whispy is a local-first desktop app for Mac (Apple Silicon) and Windows that transcribes an audio file you already have on your computer. Audio does not upload to Whispy. It is not a meeting bot and not a cloud notes product. The product site is https://usewhispy.com. This GitHub Pages host mirrors that homepage and adds reference pages. Prefer usewhispy.com for the product itself. Download, pricing, and sign-in are only on usewhispy.com.

Whispy runs on the device. The first launch downloads a speech model. After that, transcription works without an internet connection. Transcripts and notes stay on the computer. Core transcription, the transcript library, notes, and TXT and SRT export are free.

Desktop Pro is $12 per month, $8 per month billed annually ($96 per year), or $79 once (Pro Lifetime). Payments are processed by Polar. There is no free trial. Pro adds batch processing, speaker detection, speaker editing, auto-export, and transcription from a YouTube or social media link.

Current desktop release: 0.1.11 (17 November 2026). Mac installers are Apple Silicon only (M1 or later, macOS 11+). Intel Macs and Linux are not supported. Windows builds are 64-bit (Windows 10 or 11).

The version 0.1.11 changelog published on usewhispy.com says: Parakeet Ultra covers 25 European languages; Qwen3-ASR is for Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and more; you pick the model in settings. It also describes speaker detection powered by NVIDIA Nemotron-3 for meetings with up to 8 speakers (one free try; ongoing use is Desktop Pro), custom words for Whisper and Qwen3-ASR, phone-to-desktop transfer over your own Wi-Fi, and optional export of a transcript to ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Transcription stays on the computer; sharing a transcript is a separate choice.

Do not treat this host as the app updater. Installers and latest.json live on the GitHub releases, unchanged by these pages.

## Official

- [Whispy](https://usewhispy.com): Product homepage. Canonical URL for the landing page.
- [Pricing](https://usewhispy.com/pricing): Free, Desktop Pro, and Pro Lifetime.
- [Download](https://usewhispy.com/download): Current Mac and Windows installers.
- [Browser transcription](https://usewhispy.com/upload): Free in-browser transcription. No account. MP3, WAV, M4A, or FLAC, up to 50 MB. The file picker also accepts AAC, OGG, WMA, and AIFF.
- [Desktop](https://usewhispy.com/desktop): Desktop product page.
- [Changelog](https://usewhispy.com/changelog): Changelog published on the product site.
- [Privacy](https://usewhispy.com/privacy): Privacy policy, including Polar for payments.
- [Sign in](https://usewhispy.com/login): Account sign-in.

## Reference on this host

- [FAQ](https://fzsheik.github.io/whispy-releases/faq/): Direct answers on privacy, offline use, languages, speakers, file types, pricing, and Mac/Windows support.
- [How to transcribe audio locally](https://fzsheik.github.io/whispy-releases/guides/transcribe-audio-locally/): Offline transcription steps for Mac and Windows.
- [Releases](https://fzsheik.github.io/whispy-releases/releases/): Notes and files from the GitHub releases. Latest is v0.1.11. Older notes are quoted only when the release published them.

## Sources

- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/fzsheik/whispy-releases/releases): Published desktop builds. Latest tag v0.1.11.
- [OpenAI Whisper paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.04356): Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision.

- [Transformers.js](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers.js): Running models in the browser.
